svg.aria-label: Chang-Roberts leader election: Identifiers travel one way around a ring; only the largest survives a full lap.. ⟨ELECTION, my id⟩; smaller than mine: swallow it, send mine; ⟨ELECTION, larger id⟩ passes on; my own id came back: I am the leader; ⟨ELECTED, id⟩ around the ring. Only the largest identifier is never swallowed, so exactly one process sees its own return.
